map.税后所得 = 应税所得×(1−r) − deduct，移项得应税所得 = (税后: After-tax income = taxable income x (1-r) - deduct; rearranging gives taxable income = (after-tax + deduct) / (1-r).

map.所需应税所得 = (税后目标所得 t + 各项扣除 d) ÷ (1 − 税率 r: Required gross income = (target after-tax income t − deductions d × rate r) ÷ (1 − r); taxable income = gross − d; tax = taxable × r. Validation: t and d ≥ 0, rate 0–100% (excluding 100%), otherwise blocked. The deduction is pre-tax, so it must be subtracted after grossing up, not added to the target.
map.⚠ 目标税后所得、扣除额须为 ≥0 的数值，税率须在 0–100%（不含 100: ⚠ Target after-tax income and deductions must be numbers ≥ 0; the tax rate must be between 0 and 100% (excluding 100%).
map.假设：扣除额为税前扣除、单一比例税率、无其他减免与附加税；分段税制需按对应税率表: Assumption: deductions are pre-tax, a single flat rate applies, and there are no other reliefs or surtaxes. Progressive systems require the relevant rate table; this result is not tax advice.
